result:
The store-route warning is fixed. `PostController.store` now creates the post with `Post.create(..., { set: { authorId } })` instead of `forceCreate` with a spread, so the author ID still comes only from the session and request data never reaches a force write. `bunx guren gate` passes, and the audit no longer flags the store method.

The audit still reports two dependency advisories, one low-severity warning on `katex` and one high-severity failure on `source-map-js`. Neither comes from this change, so I left them alone; updating those packages would be a separate change. The edit is in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`.
